# helm-pr-generator

> Helm chart for [pr-generator](https://github.com/devops-ia/pr-generator) — automated Pull Request
> creation daemon for Kubernetes. Watches branches matching configurable regex patterns (e.g. those
> created by ArgoCD Image Updater) and opens PRs against destination branches in GitHub and Bitbucket.

## Docs

- [Chart README](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-pr-generator/blob/main/charts/pr-generator/README.md): Auto-generated values reference
- [Root README](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-pr-generator/blob/main/README.md): Installation and configuration guide
- [TESTING.md](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-pr-generator/blob/main/TESTING.md): Testing scenarios and validation commands
- [pr-generator app docs](https://context7.com/devops-ia/pr-generator): Python daemon documentation

## Quick Install

```bash
helm repo add pr-generator https://devops-ia.github.io/helm-pr-generator
helm repo update
helm install [RELEASE_NAME] pr-generator/pr-generator
```

## Install — GitHub App Authentication (default)

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set config.providers.github.owner=my-org \
  --set config.providers.github.repo=my-repo \
  --set config.providers.github.appId=123456 \
  --set config.providers.github.installationId=78901234 \
  --set secrets.github.privateKey="$(cat /path/to/private-key.pem)" \
  --set config.providers.bitbucket.workspace=my-workspace \
  --set config.providers.bitbucket.repoSlug=my-repo \
  --set secrets.bitbucket.token=my-token
```

## Install — GitHub PAT Authentication

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set config.providers.github.authMethod=pat \
  --set config.providers.github.owner=my-org \
  --set config.providers.github.repo=my-repo \
  --set secrets.github.token=ghp_yourtoken \
  --set config.providers.bitbucket.workspace=my-workspace \
  --set config.providers.bitbucket.repoSlug=my-repo \
  --set secrets.bitbucket.token=my-token
```

## Install — Production with Existing Secrets (recommended)

```bash
# Create secrets beforehand (e.g. via External Secrets Operator)
kubectl create secret generic pr-generator-github \
  --from-file=private-key.pem=/path/to/private-key.pem \
  -n pr-generator

kubectl create secret generic pr-generator-bitbucket \
  --from-literal=token=my-token \
  -n pr-generator

helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set config.providers.github.owner=my-org \
  --set config.providers.github.repo=my-repo \
  --set config.providers.github.appId=123456 \
  --set config.providers.github.installationId=78901234 \
  --set secrets.github.existingSecret=pr-generator-github \
  --set config.providers.bitbucket.workspace=my-workspace \
  --set config.providers.bitbucket.repoSlug=my-repo \
  --set secrets.bitbucket.existingSecret=pr-generator-bitbucket
```

## Install — values.yaml (recommended for complex deployments)

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  -f values.yaml
```

## Core values.yaml

```yaml
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/devops-ia/pr-generator
  tag: ""           # defaults to Chart.appVersion
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

config:
  scanFrequency: 300          # seconds between scan cycles
  logLevel: INFO              # DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR
  logFormat: text             # "text" or "json" (structured, recommended for production)
  dryRun: false
  healthPort: 8080

  providers:
    github:
      enabled: true
      authMethod: app          # "app" (GitHub App) or "pat" (Personal Access Token)
      owner: my-org
      repo: my-repo
      appId: "123456"
      installationId: ""       # auto-resolved from repo if empty
      privateKeyKey: "private-key.pem"
    bitbucket:
      enabled: true
      workspace: my-workspace
      repoSlug: my-repo
      tokenEnv: BITBUCKET_TOKEN
      closeSourceBranch: true

  rules:
    - pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-dev-.*"
      destinations:
        github: "develop"
        bitbucket: "dev"
    - pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-pro-.*"
      destinations:
        github: "main"
        bitbucket: "master"

secrets:
  github:
    existingSecret: "pr-generator-github"
  bitbucket:
    existingSecret: "pr-generator-bitbucket"
```

## Multi-Provider Setup (two GitHub orgs + two Bitbucket workspaces)

```yaml
config:
  providers:
    github:                              # type inferred from key name
      enabled: true
      authMethod: app
      owner: org-a
      repo: repo-a
      appId: "111111"
      privateKeyKey: "org-a-key.pem"    # key inside secrets.github Secret
    github-org-b:                        # non-standard name → requires type
      enabled: true
      type: github
      authMethod: pat
      owner: org-b
      repo: repo-b
      tokenEnv: GITHUB_ORG_B_TOKEN
      tokenKey: org-b-token
    bitbucket:                           # type inferred
      enabled: true
      workspace: ws-a
      repoSlug: repo-a
      tokenEnv: BITBUCKET_TOKEN
      tokenKey: token
    bitbucket-ws2:                       # non-standard name → requires type
      enabled: true
      type: bitbucket
      workspace: ws-b
      repoSlug: repo-b
      tokenEnv: BITBUCKET_WS2_TOKEN      # must be unique per provider
      tokenKey: ws2-token

  rules:
    - pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-dev-.*"
      destinations:
        github: develop
        github-org-b: develop
        bitbucket: dev
        bitbucket-ws2: dev
```

## Annotation-based Rule Discovery (ArgoCD)

Mirrors the ArgoCD Image Updater model: each ArgoCD Application CR declares its own PR rules
via annotations. No central `config.rules` change needed when onboarding a new application.

```yaml
annotationDiscovery:
  enabled: true
  mode: hybrid          # config_only | annotations_only | hybrid
  annotationPrefix: "pr-generator.io"
```

Mode semantics:
- `config_only` — static `config.rules` only; no Kubernetes API access (default, safe)
- `annotations_only` — rules come exclusively from ArgoCD Application annotations; `config.rules` ignored
- `hybrid` — both sources active; annotation destinations take precedence on same pattern+provider collision

Enabling `annotationDiscovery` automatically:
- Creates a ClusterRole granting `get`/`list` on `applications.argoproj.io`
- Creates a ClusterRoleBinding for the chart ServiceAccount
- Sets `automountServiceAccountToken: true` on the pod (overrides SA-level `false`)

Annotation schema on an ArgoCD Application (using default prefix `pr-generator.io`):

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: my-app
  namespace: argocd
  annotations:
    pr-generator.io/enabled: "true"
    pr-generator.io/pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-dev-.*"
    pr-generator.io/destination.github: "develop"
    pr-generator.io/destination.bitbucket: "dev"
```

The `destination.<provider-key>` suffix maps to keys under `config.providers`.

Install with annotation discovery enabled:

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set annotationDiscovery.enabled=true \
  --set annotationDiscovery.mode=hybrid \
  --set config.providers.github.owner=my-org \
  --set config.providers.github.repo=my-repo \
  --set config.providers.github.appId=123456 \
  --set secrets.github.existingSecret=pr-generator-github
```

## Prometheus Metrics

The app exposes `/metrics` (Prometheus format) on the same port as the health server (default `8080`).
`metrics.enabled: true` is the default — no extra configuration needed for basic scraping.

### Available metrics

| Metric | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pr_generator_prs_created_total` | Counter | PRs successfully created, by provider and destination |
| `pr_generator_prs_skipped_total` | Counter | PRs skipped (already exists), by provider and destination |
| `pr_generator_prs_failed_total` | Counter | PR creation failures, by provider and error_type |
| `pr_generator_scan_cycles_total` | Counter | Completed scan cycles, by result (success/partial/error) |
| `pr_generator_scan_duration_seconds` | Histogram | Scan cycle wall-clock duration |
| `pr_generator_rules_active` | Gauge | Active scan rules at end of last cycle |
| `pr_generator_annotation_rules_discovered` | Gauge | Rules discovered from ArgoCD annotations |
| `pr_generator_provider_errors_total` | Counter | Provider-level errors, by provider and error_type |
| `pr_generator_up` | Gauge | 1 if the daemon completed at least one scan cycle, 0 otherwise |

### Pod annotations (scrape without Prometheus Operator)

```yaml
metrics:
  enabled: true
  podAnnotations:
    prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
    prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
    prometheus.io/port: "8080"
```

### ServiceMonitor (Prometheus Operator)

```yaml
metrics:
  enabled: true
  serviceMonitor:
    enabled: true          # requires Prometheus Operator CRDs
    interval: 30s
    scrapeTimeout: 10s
    labels: {}             # must match Operator's serviceMonitorSelector
    namespace: ""          # defaults to Release.Namespace
```

Install with ServiceMonitor:

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled=true \
  --set metrics.serviceMonitor.labels.release=kube-prometheus-stack
```

Scrape the metrics endpoint manually:

```bash
kubectl port-forward svc/pr-generator 8080:8080 -n pr-generator
curl -s http://localhost:8080/metrics | grep pr_generator
```

## Scan Rules Configuration

```yaml
config:
  rules:
    # Each rule: a branch regex pattern + map of provider-key → destination branch
    - pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-dev-.*"
      destinations:
        github: "develop"
        bitbucket: "dev"
    - pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-staging-.*"
      destinations:
        github: "staging"
    - pattern: "argocd-image-updater-.*-pro-.*"
      destinations:
        github: "main"
        bitbucket: "master"
```

Rules can be empty (`[]`) when `annotationDiscovery.mode: annotations_only`.
For `config_only` mode at least one rule is required (enforced at runtime by the daemon).

## Health Endpoints

The health server runs on `config.healthPort` (default `8080`).

| Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|
| `GET /livez` | Liveness — returns 200 when the process is alive |
| `GET /readyz` | Readiness — returns 200 after the first scan cycle completes |
| `GET /healthz` | Combined liveness + readiness |
| `GET /metrics` | Prometheus metrics (when `metrics.enabled: true`) |

```bash
kubectl port-forward svc/pr-generator 8080:8080 -n pr-generator
curl http://localhost:8080/livez    # {"status":"ok"}
curl http://localhost:8080/readyz   # {"status":"ok"} after first cycle
curl http://localhost:8080/healthz
curl http://localhost:8080/metrics
```

## ServiceAccount and RBAC

```yaml
serviceAccount:
  create: true          # set false to use an existing SA
  name: ""              # defaults to fullname; use "default" when create=false
  annotations: {}       # for EKS Pod Identity / Workload Identity bindings
```

When `annotationDiscovery.enabled=true`, a ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding are created
automatically to grant the SA read access to `applications.argoproj.io` cluster-wide.

## PodDisruptionBudget

```yaml
podDisruptionBudget:
  enabled: true
  minAvailable: 1
```

Note: `replicas` is hardcoded to `1`. PDB with `minAvailable: 1` prevents voluntary eviction
(node drains) but does not help with availability — it is useful mainly to block disruptions
during cluster maintenance.

## Resource Limits

```yaml
resources:
  limits:
    memory: 256Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
```

## Security Context

```yaml
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL
```

## Startup Probe (optional)

Useful when the app needs extra time on first boot to resolve the GitHub App installation ID.

```yaml
startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /livez
    port: health
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 12    # up to 60 s grace before liveness kicks in
```

## Dry-run Mode

Logs PR creation without actually opening PRs. Useful for validating rule patterns.

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set config.dryRun=true \
  --set config.logLevel=DEBUG \
  --set config.providers.github.owner=my-org \
  --set config.providers.github.repo=my-repo \
  --set config.providers.github.appId=123456 \
  --set secrets.github.existingSecret=pr-generator-github
```

## Custom Scan Rules via CLI

```bash
helm install pr-generator devops-ia/pr-generator \
  --namespace pr-generator \
  --create-namespace \
  --set 'config.rules[0].pattern=argocd-image-updater-.*-dev-.*' \
  --set 'config.rules[0].destinations.github=develop' \
  --set 'config.rules[0].destinations.bitbucket=dev' \
  --set 'config.rules[1].pattern=argocd-image-updater-.*-pro-.*' \
  --set 'config.rules[1].destinations.github=main' \
  --set 'config.rules[1].destinations.bitbucket=master'
```

## Validation Commands

```bash
# Verify pod is running
kubectl describe pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pr-generator -n pr-generator

# Check rendered config
kubectl exec -it deploy/pr-generator -n pr-generator -- cat /etc/pr-generator/config.yaml

# Stream logs
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pr-generator -n pr-generator -f

# Health checks
kubectl port-forward svc/pr-generator 8080:8080 -n pr-generator &
curl http://localhost:8080/livez
curl http://localhost:8080/readyz

# Metrics
curl -s http://localhost:8080/metrics | grep pr_generator
```

## Uninstall

```bash
helm uninstall pr-generator -n pr-generator
```
